title: Food-at-home prices rose sharply before annual inflation moderated
source_unit: monthly unadjusted CPI-U food-at-home and all-items index observations, summarized by calendar year

denominator.unit: monthly CPI-U observations in calendar year

observations.method: Arithmetic mean of the 12 monthly unadjusted CPI-U index values returned by the official BLS Public Data API; annual percent change is not defined for the first year.
observations.uncertainty: CPI is a statistical price index rather than a household-specific basket; annual averaging masks within-year timing and subgroup or local price differences.
observations.subgroup: CPI-U food at home and all items; national aggregate
observations.counterinterpretation: An aggregate index does not show which households experienced food-price pressure, what they substituted, or whether resources kept pace.

boundary: This is a national CPI-U price-pressure series, not a household food-security estimate, a local price series, a real-income estimate, or a causal test. It is intended to be aligned with USDA food-security and household-response records while preserving separate units and timing.
